articles.title: Winklevoss-backed Zcash ETF files with SEC for Nasdaq listing
articles.snippet: The proposed fund would hold ZEC directly, with Gemini Trust serving as custodian and Winklevoss Capital affiliates eyeing up to a $100 million investment.

articles.title: Chinese crime network laundered over $1B for Lazarus: ZachXBT
articles.snippet: ZachXBT says he infiltrated the network by posing as a customer, gaining information that helped trace funds from the $1.5 billion Bybit hack.

articles.title: Bryan Johnson Spent Millions to Reverse Aging. He Says a Filter Works Better
articles.snippet: The face of the "Don't Die" movement now says retouching beats therapy for looking young. His transformation over the summer may explain why.

articles.title: Another Zcash ETF Is Coming: Winklevoss Twins File for 'WINK'
articles.snippet: The proposed fund would hold ZEC directly, trade on Nasdaq under "WINK" with Gemini as custodian, and add the Winklevoss twins to a wave of institutional interest in the privacy coin.

articles.title: DeFi Development Corp Adds $3 Million in Solana as SOL Buys Slow
articles.snippet: Nasdaq-listed DeFi Development Corp's latest SEC filing shows its Solana stash grew 1%, to about 2.56 million SOL and SOL equivalents—roughly half the prior week's gain and well below mid-September's pace.
